title: CFA® Program (Chartered Financial Analyst)
source: CFA Institute Candidate Body of Knowledge (CBOK) 2025-2026
summary: The gold standard in global investment management and financial analysis: 3 sequential examination levels, mandatory Practical Skills Modules (PSMs) in Python/AI and financial modeling, and 2025+ Level III specialized pathways.

portfolio-mgmt.name: Portfolio Management Pathway (Traditional Track)
portfolio-mgmt.blurb: Focuses on institutional fund management, asset allocation, active equity/fixed income strategies, trade execution, and performance attribution.

stages.title: Stage 1: CFA Level I – Investment Tools
stages.subtitle: 180 CBT MCQs across two 135-min sessions + Mandatory Practical Skills Module

nodes.name: CFA Level I Examination
nodes.description: Comprehensive computer-based examination evaluating foundational investment tools, ethical standards, financial reporting, asset classes, and quantitative methods.
topics: Ethical and Professional Standards & Code of Conduct (15-20%)
Financial Statement Analysis & IFRS/US GAAP Reporting Quality (11-14%)
Equity Investments & Market Organization (11-14%)
Fixed Income Securities & Yield Measures (11-14%)
Quantitative Methods, TVM & Probability (6-9%)
Economics: Micro, Macro & Foreign Exchange (6-9%)
Corporate Issuers: Governance, Capital Structure & ESG (6-9%)
Portfolio Management & Wealth Planning Basics (8-11%)
Alternative Investments & Real Assets (7-10%)
Derivatives Principles & Forward Commitments (5-8%)
learningOutcomes: Calculate time value of money, statistical risk/return, and hypothesis tests
Analyze balance sheets, income statements, cash flows, and inventory accounting
Evaluate fixed income duration, convexity, credit risk, and bond valuation
Apply the CFA Institute Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct
checklists: Verify eligibility (final 23 months of Bachelor's or 4,000h work/education)
Complete 300+ hours of focused study across all 10 CBOK topic areas
Score 70%+ on CFA Institute official mock exams under timed Prometric conditions
resources: CFA Institute Learning Ecosystem (LES) official curriculum
CFA Institute Standards of Practice Handbook (11th Edition)

nodes.name: Mandatory PSM I: Python or Financial Modeling
nodes.description: Mandatory Practical Skills Module required for Level I exam results release. Candidate selects Python Programming Fundamentals or 3-Statement Financial Modeling.
topics: Option A: Python Programming Fundamentals (data structures, loops, functions, pandas, NumPy)
Option B: Financial Modeling in Excel (3-statement dynamic projection models, debt schedules, DCF mechanics)
learningOutcomes: Develop algorithmic scripts or dynamic financial models reflecting corporate reality
Manipulate real-world financial time-series data using modern computational tools
checklists: Complete all interactive coding or modeling exercises prior to exam result release window
resources: CFA Institute Practical Skills Module Portal

stages.title: Stage 2: CFA Level II – Asset Valuation
stages.subtitle: 88 CBT MCQs across 22 Item-Set Vignettes + Mandatory Practical Skills Module

nodes.name: CFA Level II Examination
nodes.format: 88 Questions (22 Vignettes / Item Sets with 4 MCQs each)
nodes.description: Rigorous vignette-based examination testing deep asset valuation, financial statement forensics, multinational operations, multifactor risk models, and corporate restructuring.
topics: Ethical and Professional Standards Vignette Applications (10-15%)
Financial Statement Analysis: Intercorporate Investments, Pensions & Multinational (10-15%)
Equity Valuation: Multi-stage DDM, DCF (FCFF/FCFE), Residual Income & Multiples (10-15%)
Fixed Income: Term Structure, Binomial Trees, Embedded Options & CDS (10-15%)
Portfolio Management: Multifactor Models, Active Risk & Algorithmic Execution (10-15%)
Derivatives: Arbitrage-Free Forward Commitments & Black-Scholes Greeks (5-10%)
Alternative Investments: Private Equity Waterfalls, Real Estate & Commodities (5-10%)
Corporate Issuers: M&A, Capital Structure Dynamics & Corporate Restructuring (5-10%)
Economics: Currency Exchange Rates Equilibrium & Growth Theories (5-10%)
Quantitative Methods: Multiple Regression, Time-Series & Machine Learning (5-10%)
learningOutcomes: Execute multi-stage discounted cash flow valuations and equity multiplier comparisons
Price complex fixed income securities with embedded options using arbitrage-free trees
Translate multinational foreign subsidiary financial statements under temporal and current rate methods
checklists: Pass CFA Level I examination and complete Level I PSM
Study 325+ hours focusing on complex multi-page financial vignette dissection
Practice time management (12 minutes per 4-question vignette)
resources: CFA Institute Level II Official Candidate Curriculum & Item Sets

nodes.name: Mandatory PSM II: Python/AI or Analyst Skills
nodes.description: Mandatory Practical Skills Module required for Level II results release. Candidate selects Python, Data Science & AI or Buy-Side/Sell-Side Financial Analyst Skills.
topics: Option A: Python, Data Science & AI (supervised learning, NLP sentiment analysis on 10-K filings, feature engineering)
Option B: Financial Analyst Skills (sell-side research note drafting, CapIQ/Bloomberg modeling, earnings call analysis)
learningOutcomes: Build predictive financial machine learning pipelines or publish a professional equity research initiation memo
checklists: Complete all laboratory assignments prior to Level II score dissemination

stages.title: Stage 3: Level III – Portfolio Management Pathway (2025+)
stages.subtitle: Common Core (65–70%) + Institutional PM Specialization (30–35%)

nodes.name: Level III Curriculum: Common Core + Institutional PM
nodes.description: In-depth mastery of the Level III Common Core coupled with Institutional Portfolio Management (Active Equity, Active Fixed Income, Trade Execution).
topics: Common Core: Ethical and Professional Standards & GIPS Compliance (10-15%)
Common Core: Capital Market Expectations & Macroeconomic Forecasting (5-10%)
Common Core: Asset Allocation & Liability-Driven Investing (LDI) (10-15%)
Common Core: Performance Measurement, Attribution & Appraisal (5-10%)
Common Core: Derivatives in Risk Management & Currency Overlay (5-10%)
PM Pathway: Active Equity Portfolio Construction & Quantitative Strategies (10-15%)
PM Pathway: Active Fixed Income & Yield Curve Strategies (10-15%)
PM Pathway: Trade Execution, Market Microstructure & Algorithmic Costs (5-10%)
PM Pathway: Institutional Investors (Pension Funds, Sovereign Wealth, Endowments)
learningOutcomes: Construct multi-asset institutional portfolios matching defined benefit liabilities
Decompose investment performance into asset allocation and security selection alpha using Brinson attribution
Formulate comprehensive Investment Policy Statements (IPS) for institutional mandates

nodes.name: CFA Level III Examination Sitting
nodes.format: 11 Item Sets: Constructed Response (Essay) & MCQ Vignettes
nodes.description: Unified Level III computer-based examination sitting combining constructed response essay scenarios and item sets testing synthesis and portfolio decision-making.

nodes.name: Mandatory PSM III: Portfolio Construction
nodes.description: Mandatory Practical Skills Module in Portfolio Development & Construction: building multi-asset portfolios, stress-testing constraints, tracking error optimization, and dynamic rebalancing.

stages.title: Stage 4: Charterholder Credential & Experience
stages.subtitle: 4,000 Hours Verified Investment Experience + Professional Conduct Statement

nodes.name: 4,000 Hours Investment Decision-Making Experience
nodes.description: Accrue at least 4,000 hours of qualifying professional work experience in investment decision-making, portfolio management, financial analysis, or economic research.
topics: Direct involvement in investment decision-making process
Producing analytical work product informing portfolio asset allocations
Supervision of investment analysis and fiduciary asset management
checklists: Document 4,000 hours over at least 36 calendar months in CFA Institute portal
Obtain 2 to 3 professional sponsor reference sign-offs (preferably CFA charterholders)
resources: CFA Institute Work Experience Guidelines and Verification Portal

nodes.name: CFA Charter Conferred & Ethics Statement
nodes.description: Formal award of the Chartered Financial Analyst® designation, admission to regular membership in CFA Institute and local society, and annual execution of the Professional Conduct Statement.
topics: Regular Membership in CFA Institute and local society
Annual Professional Conduct Statement adherence
Right to use the prestigious CFA® credential
checklists: Submit formal charterholder application upon passing Level III and verifying experience
Execute annual Professional Conduct Statement and pay society dues

private-wealth.blurb: Tailored for wealth advisors, family office principals, and private bankers managing ultra-high-net-worth client portfolios and cross-border estates.
